text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When they change or add new code, they can run the tests to see if anything breaks. Without tests, it is easy to miss mistakes and create new problems. In short, testing saves time and helps teams build better, more reliable software.
